title: LiteMedSAM leads a narrow CT box-prompt calibration on Mac
claim: On 18 reference-selected organ-slice pairs from one CT, LiteMedSAM MPS mean Dice was 0.8334/0.8524 for tighter/wider boxes, versus SAM2 MPS 0.7745/0.5165 and SAM2 CPU 0.7905/0.5593. This establishes local feasibility and conditional mask quality, not autonomous or volumetric performance.
limitations: One known public CT; three correlated slices for each of six organs.
Reference-derived slice selection and box localization; training overlap unverified.
No agent interaction, 3D propagation, clinical validation or unseen-data generalization claim.
SAM2 CPU and MPS differ materially; backend-specific results retained. LiteMedSAM parity checked on four predictions only.
Warm timings exclude startup; sampled Metal allocation is not a true total peak memory measure.
